name: disaster-app
description: Disaster Management and Shelter Navigation platform

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.check:sql: node scripts/check-sql.mjs > sql-dump.json && python3 scripts/check-sql.py sql-dump.json
